sections.discharge_instructions: Get adequate rest and avoid overexertion. Cardiology follow-up within 1-2 weeks. Cardiac rehabilitation enrollment recommended. sections.care_plan: Care plan: Nursing problem: acute pain (chest pain). Goal: Chest pain resolves and the activity level can be widened with stable hemodynamics and ECG.
